businesses.business: Mailing and shipping technology and services

offering_description.value: Pitney Bowes sells mailing equipment, postage and shipping software, and supplies to businesses and government agencies. It collects, sorts, and consolidates bulk mail at its presort facilities before handing it to the U.S. Postal Service. It also offers equipment financing and postage payment services.

primary_products.value: postage meters and mailing systems; mailing and shipping software; folder inserters; mailing and shipping supplies

primary_services.value: bulk mail collection and presorting; equipment maintenance and repair; equipment financing; postage payment services

customer_segment.value: B2B: Small businesses, corporate mailrooms, commercial printers, and high-volume mailers; B2G: Federal, state, and local government mailrooms

end_markets.value: business mailing and parcel shipping; direct mail marketing; financial services; healthcare; public administration

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: Postage meters and other mailing equipment; subscription: Cloud mailing and shipping software; product sales: Mailing equipment, ink, labels, and other supplies; service fees: Bulk mail presorting, equipment maintenance, and payment services; interest or premiums: Equipment financing and postage credit
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; subscription; product sales; service fees; interest or premiums

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Develops mailing systems from hardware and software components for business and government mailrooms; software / platform: Connects postal and carrier services with business and government mailrooms; service provider: Collects and sorts outgoing mail for businesses and public agencies; asset operator: Operates presort facilities that process customer mail for postal induction; financial intermediary: Provides equipment financing and postage credit to commercial customers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; software / platform; service provider; asset operator; financial intermediary

geography_served.value: global: United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, and other international markets, with presort operations in the United States

specialization.value: related lines: Mailing equipment, mailing and shipping software, bulk mail presort, and customer financing

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales teams serving business and government accounts; online: Company website for software subscriptions and supply orders; distributors / dealers: Independent dealers for mailing equipment and supplies
